notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your understanding and support, we continue working on the game and below we leave you the list of changes.

- The Player Controller has been redefined, making it much more fluid, and less clunky
- Now the "W" and "S" keys will be used to choose the options, making this much more intuitive
- The bug that caused people to be unable to move when the neighbor caught you has been fixed
- General bugs have been resolved

We take advantage of this opportunity to mention that we are in the planning of the second game, which will maintain this same style, and will be set during the Black Death period. We have taken notes of all the feedback and we are going to make a much better experience.

Thank you all! We love you!
